criterion: 各實際 OS 資源及同時使用的總預算可追溯；未知與實測區分，建立失敗／耗盡有處置與異常；取消／重啟不累積資源，共享資料在用期間不被回收；沒有無界擴容或未確認的配置回退。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: OS-RES-001 and resource tables distinguish typed project budgets, basis/measurement and actual simultaneous demand including OS overhead. Creation failure, exhaustion, cancellation/restart and live shared references retain defined handling.
